scope.summary: Author the hip channels per Section 13.17 (BK-17.3, TAI-BK-043), closing OBR-003's hip clause: hip_bone_width (Skeletal: pelvis frame width, separate from glute volume/shape and from every breast/shoulder channel) and pelvis_tilt (Skeletal: its own posture axis), decoupled in both directions from all tissue volume channels.
acceptance_criteria: hip_bone_width and pelvis_tilt are registered kind Skeletal, group_key 'hip', with skeletal semantics routed through the 13.18 joint re-derivation lane (bone placement, not vertex morphs beyond the hip skeletal mask).
No default coupling exists between 'hip' and any of 'glute'/'breast'/'shoulder'/'thigh' groups; negative test asserts an empty default coupling graph for these pairs.
Sweep test: hip_bone_width full range moves zero glute-mask and zero thigh-mask vertices (tissue regions unaffected by frame width beyond declared hip skeletal mask); BODY_DECOUPLE_VALID green.
Narrow-hips + max-glute reachability sample: hip_bone_width at min + glute_volume at max (once MT-502 lands; until then a fixture glute morph) evaluates artifact-free.
Both channels addressable via the channel API with mm-authority/cm-surface conversion correct for width values.
scope.risk_if_missed: Breast/hip/shoulder width linkage is the operator's named removal target (OBR-004: 'this coupling MUST be removed'); a hip frame that drags glutes or follows bust reintroduces the Daz failure at the pelvis, breaking archetype (a)'s narrow-hips requirement.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend/solver scope: behavior is observable via TraceProjection, typed TAILOR_BODY_* receipts, and the 13.12 capture APIs; operator/model GUI exposure rides the BodyKit panes (13.27) and is validated there.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: Emits/extends the TAILOR_BODY_* KernelEventType family on the EventLedger per Section 13.16 (extends the 13.14 canonical list).
internal_diagnostics ships with WP-KERNEL-012; wire the open diagnostic-event API for this behavior in the WP-KERNEL-016 retrofit.
Palmistry external watcher ships with WP-KERNEL-012/016; long generation/bake/export runs get child-stall watch coverage in the retrofit.

risks: Broad MT scope can hide multiple review targets.
Markdown MT lists may disagree with packet-declared active/next MT truth.
Receipt routing may target an old MT if contract identity is omitted.
minimum_controls: Exactly one primary proof target per MT unless the packet records why not.
MT identity must be stable and referenced by receipt correlation.
Generated projection drift must not wake Coder or Validator by itself.
